title: Observatory STAC Extension (development)
description: Continuously developing Observatory metadata extension for column semantics and in-situ station metadata. Not a STAC community extension or a released version. Validate together with STAC core and the Table and CF extensions when used.
$comment: DEVELOPMENT SCHEMA: this stable unversioned URL intentionally tracks ongoing work deployed from main. It may change incompatibly without a version bump. Do not use it as a release identifier or for immutable production declarations.

in_situ:station_altitude.title: Station elevation above sea level
in_situ:station_altitude.description: Station elevation above sea level in metres, preserving ICOS cpmeta:hasElevation. Precise datum and station reference point may be unknown. Not sensor height or WGS 84 ellipsoidal height; never automatically copy to GeoJSON z.

in_situ:station_altitude_vertical_datum.title: Station elevation vertical datum
in_situ:station_altitude_vertical_datum.description: Verified vertical datum or CRS identifier, preferably an authoritative URI. Omit when unknown.

in_situ:sensor_height_above_ground.title: Sensor or sampling inlet height above ground
in_situ:sensor_height_above_ground.description: Vertical distance in metres above local ground to the sensor or sampling inlet. Use only when the ground reference is verified. ICOS samplingHeight alone does not establish that reference.

in_situ:sampling_height.title: Sampling height
in_situ:sampling_height.description: Sampling height in metres, preserving ICOS cpmeta:hasSamplingHeight when its reference surface has not been verified. Not absolute elevation.

timeStep.description: A positive integer multiple of years, months, days, hours, minutes or seconds. Whole milliseconds may be expressed as fractional seconds. No weeks or mixed-unit steps.

years.title: Years
years.description: Signed number of calendar years, applied together with months in the calendar of obs:timezone_offset.

months.title: Months
months.description: Signed number of calendar months, applied together with years in the calendar of obs:timezone_offset.

days.title: Days
days.description: Signed number of elapsed days, applied after years and months.

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: Signed number of elapsed hours, applied after years and months.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: Signed number of elapsed minutes, applied after years and months.

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: Signed number of elapsed seconds, applied after years and months.

milliseconds.title: Milliseconds
milliseconds.description: Signed number of elapsed milliseconds, applied after years and months.

timeOffset.description: Signed calendar years/months in the temporal dimension's obs:timezone_offset (UTC if omitted), then elapsed days/time. Empty object means zero. Impossible dates are errors, never clamped.

integration.title: Sample temporal integration
integration.description: Variable-level temporal support, or a default on a temporal dimension. Use instantaneous for point observations, or an object for half-open integration intervals. A variable's declaration or CF point method overrides dimension defaults. Native coordinate-cell bounds alone do not establish integration. Overlapping observations are allowed; aggregation may require non-overlapping inputs.

oneOf.title: Instantaneous
oneOf.description: Explicitly non-integrated measurements at the sample timestamps. Shared native coordinate-cell bounds are permitted, but are not this variable's integration intervals.

start.title: Interval start offset
start.description: Offset of the start of each half-open integration interval from its reference time. Empty object means zero.

end.title: Interval end offset
end.description: Offset of the end of each half-open integration interval from its reference time. Intervals must have positive length.

reference.title: Offset reference
reference.description: The time that the start and end offsets are relative to.

oneOf.title: Sample timestamp
oneOf.description: The exact sample timestamp, or the expanded shorthand sample label. Default.

oneOf.title: Nominal grid slot
oneOf.description: The nominal grid slot of the sample. Requires a sampling grid.

start_column.title: Interval start column
start_column.description: Table column with the start of each row's integration interval. Bounds of shorthand sample labels are RFC 3339 timestamps.

end_column.title: Interval end column
end_column.description: Table column with the end of each row's integration interval. Bounds of shorthand sample labels are RFC 3339 timestamps.

obs:origin.title: Sampling origin
obs:origin.description: Exact RFC 3339 grid anchor, normalized to UTC. Calendar arithmetic uses obs:timezone_offset, not the offset written in this timestamp. Monthly grids require days 1-28 and yearly grids forbid February 29 in that calendar. The phase, including time of day, is retained.

obs:timezone_offset.title: Fixed UTC offset
obs:timezone_offset.description: Integer minutes east of UTC: 120 means UTC+02:00, -300 means UTC-05:00. Used to decode timezone-free sample/bounds labels and for sampling/integration calendar arithmetic. Explicit timestamp offsets remain authoritative for their instants. Does not alter STAC coverage timestamps or native CF time decoding. Defaults to UTC; never applies DST, solar time or machine-local timezone.

obs:nominal_step.title: Approximate sampling cadence
obs:nominal_step.description: Nominal grid used for alignment without replacing exact acquisition timestamps. Actual Datacube step must be null.

obs:alignment_tolerance.title: Nominal alignment tolerance
obs:alignment_tolerance.description: Maximum deviation in milliseconds, strictly less than half the shortest sampling step. At most one observation per nominal slot; never silently merges samples.

obs:timestamp_column.title: Table timestamp column
obs:timestamp_column.description: Table column containing sample labels or exact timestamps.

obs:timestamp_format.title: Table timestamp encoding
obs:timestamp_format.description: How the timestamp column encodes times. Shorthand years and months expand to their grid coordinate, including the origin's phase. Timezone-free labels use obs:timezone_offset.

oneOf.title: ISO 8601
oneOf.description: ISO 8601 date-times. Explicit offsets determine their own instants; timestamps without an offset use obs:timezone_offset.

oneOf.title: Compact date and time
oneOf.description: Year, month, day, hour and minute without separators, for example 202601311230.

oneOf.title: Year
oneOf.description: Year label, for example 2026, expanded to the grid coordinate of that year.

oneOf.title: Year and month
oneOf.description: Year-month label, for example 2026-01, expanded to the grid coordinate of that month.

name.title: Column name
name.description: Name of the column, as in the Table extension. Must be unique within table:columns; obs:related refers to columns by this name.

obs:temporal_extent.title: Column temporal coverage
obs:temporal_extent.description: Inclusive temporal coverage of values in this column, independent of other columns. Use ISO calendar dates (whole days) or RFC 3339 timestamps with offsets, retaining source precision; null means an open bound. At least one bound must be known and start must not be after end. Do not invent UTC instants from dates.

cf:cell_methods.title: CF cell methods
cf:cell_methods.description: CF v1.0.0 cell-method array, extended to Table columns. Use actual aggregation axes, for example time: standard_deviation only after confirming the temporal sample domain. Not an uncertainty declaration.

obs:role.title: Column role
obs:role.description: measurement: selectable observed or derived quantity; coordinate: time/position/index; ancillary: companion statistics, quality or processing status; diagnostic: instrument or processing diagnostic.

oneOf.title: Measurement
oneOf.description: Selectable observed or derived quantity, including categorical quantities.

oneOf.title: Coordinate
oneOf.description: Time, position or index.

oneOf.title: Ancillary
oneOf.description: Companion statistics, quality or processing status that describe another variable.

oneOf.title: Diagnostic
oneOf.description: Instrument or processing diagnostic.

obs:related.title: Related columns
obs:related.description: Companion columns for this variable in the same table: one value per matching row. Targets must exist and column names must be unique. No inference from names or units alone.

obs:categories.title: Category meanings
obs:categories.description: Exact categorical values, not bit masks or an implied quality ranking. Values and machine-readable meanings must each be unique. Processing methods are not automatically good/bad quality.

value.title: Value
value.description: The categorical value as stored in the column: a number, string or boolean.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.description: Machine-readable meaning of the value as a lowercase snake_case identifier, unique within the list.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable label of the category, for example the wording of the source.

cf:standard_name.title: CF standard name
cf:standard_name.description: A CF standard name, optionally followed by one CF standard-name modifier separated by one space. This extension adds Table column placement; it does not redefine CF. Check the name and physical units against the published CF vocabulary. Standard deviation is a cell method, not a standard-name modifier.

column.title: Companion column
column.description: Exact, case-sensitive name of the companion column in the same table:columns array. Values are aligned row by row; self references are invalid.

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: What the companion column says about this column. The direction is from this column to the companion.

oneOf.title: Quality flag
oneOf.description: Companion codes describe the quality of this variable; the codebook is required for interpretation.

oneOf.title: Processing flag
oneOf.description: Companion codes describe provenance or processing, for example measured versus gap-filled. Not a quality ranking.

oneOf.title: Standard deviation
oneOf.description: Companion gives the statistical spread of the same quantity, population, coordinate frame and sample domain. Not automatically the uncertainty of a mean or flux.

oneOf.title: Standard error
oneOf.description: Companion gives the uncertainty as defined by CF; the stored value is multiplier times one standard error. Requires uncertainty_type.

oneOf.title: Confidence interval lower bound
oneOf.description: Companion gives the lower endpoint of a confidence interval, not a distance from the estimate. Requires the upper bound with the same confidence_level and uncertainty_type.

oneOf.title: Confidence interval upper bound
oneOf.description: Companion gives the upper endpoint of a confidence interval, not a distance from the estimate. Requires the lower bound with the same confidence_level and uncertainty_type.

oneOf.title: Number of observations
oneOf.description: Companion counts the observations underlying this value; unit 1.

oneOf.title: Detection minimum
oneOf.description: Companion gives the smallest detectable signal, in units compatible with this column.

confidence_level.title: Confidence level
confidence_level.description: Confidence level of the interval as a fraction strictly between 0 and 1, for example 0.95 (not 95). Required for confidence interval bounds, not allowed for other relations.

uncertainty_type.title: Uncertainty type
uncertainty_type.description: Whether the uncertainty values are absolute or relative. Required for standard errors and confidence interval bounds, not allowed for other relations.

oneOf.title: Absolute
oneOf.description: In units compatible with this column: difference units for a standard error, the column's own units for interval endpoints.

oneOf.title: Relative
oneOf.description: Dimensionless fractions of this column's value (0.05 means 5%); interval endpoints are ratios to the value, not relative half-widths.

multiplier.title: Multiplier
multiplier.description: For standard errors only: the stored value is this multiple of one standard error. Defaults to 1.
